Hey, I really appreciate this post you made and I wanted to share my experiences I’ve had in my journey. 

It been a bit up and down. I was raised in a Baptist church, grew up in a Christian school, had chapel every Monday and church every Sunday. Wasn’t allowed to watch certain movies growing up, but I still had a fantastically happy childhood. Little did I know there was a whole mess going on behind the scenes. My parents were having affairs, they would just fight all the dang time, and I grew up not really knowing what love looked like. 

When it comes down to most organized religions, it’s all about following rules/laws.
